test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian scheme is funded by a 0.5% cess levied on all taxable products since Nov 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To **give wings to this vision**, the **Government of India **initiated a tax known as **'Swachh Bharat Cess' **at **0.5% **on **all taxable services **to fund **Swachh Bharat initiatives**.
 
• The **service tax rate including **the **Swachh Bharat Cess **stands at **14.50%**
 
• **Swachh Bharat Mission**, **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**, or **Clean India Mission **is a **country-wide campaign **initiated by **the Government of India **in **2014 **to **eliminate open defecation **and **improve solid waste management**.
 
• It started to **accelerate **the **efforts **to achieve universal **sanitation coverage **and **put the focus on sanitation**. 
 
• It was **launched **by the **Prime Minister of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stand Up India Scheme **facilitates **bank loans **between **10 lakh and 1 crore **to at least **one scheduled caste (SC) **or **Scehduled Tribe**, borrower, and at least **one woman per bank branch **for setting up a **greenfield enterprise**.
 
• **Kisan Vikas Patra **is a **saving certificate scheme **that was first **launched in 1988 **by **India Post**. It was **successful **in the **early months **but afterward, the **Government of India **set up a committee under the **supervision of Shyamala Gopinath**.
 
• **Make in India **is an **initiative **by the **Government of India **to make and **encourage companies to develop**, **manufacture **and **assemble products **made **in India **and **incentivize **dedicated **investments **into **manufacturing**.
